title: Conquest of the Realms - Playtest
author: Smalltime-studios
selftext:
**Title:**

Conquest of the Realms

**Body:**

Conquest of the Realms brings hero-driven combat, persistent town progression and army management into a fantasy world where players fight to strengthen their realm. Cooperative adventures and territorial player-versus-player battles connect personal advancement with a wider struggle for control.

Five distinct realms surround the otherworldly Nexus: icy Frostvale, the green hills of Southreach, the volcanic wastes of Dreadholm, the deserts of Sunara and the shadowed swamps of Valemoor. Players build their power at home while preparing to venture into contested territory.

You can join our playtest and play the game today from our Steam page!  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5403020/Conquest\_of\_the\_Realms/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5403020/Conquest_of_the_Realms/)

We also have mobile versions available on the respective mobile app stores for Android and iOS.

*Disclaimer: We have used AI to assist in developing the game. We are a small studio of friends who are gamers, and leveraging our skills where we can, and filling the gaps with AI.*
